title: Origin story: Krishna
description: Krishna was the eighth avatar of Vishnu, born in a prison cell to Devaki as the tyrant Kamsa sought to kill him. Smuggled to Gokul, he grew as a cowherd, lifting Mount Govardhan to shelter villagers from Indra's storm, and later served as Arjuna's charioteer, delivering the Bhagavad Gita on Kurukshetra's field.
